messages.的中時に次のターンへランダムな状態異常を付け、討伐時に味方へランダムなバフを配る: A Gluttony Blunt E.G.O that inflicts a random status effect next turn on hit and hands out random buffs to allies on kills.
messages.ランダムな状態異常: 火傷・出血・振動・破裂・沈潜のうち1つを次のターンに付与す: **Random status effect**: Inflicts one of Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, or Sinking next turn. The amount is 2 + highest Gluttony Absolute Resonance (up to 5, 7 at Threadspin Ⅳ), and you cannot choose which status effect.
messages.討伐時のバフ配布(解析Ⅲ): 敵を倒すと、ランダムな味方2名に呼吸・クイック・攻: **Buffs on kills (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: Defeating an enemy gives 2 random allies one of Poise, Haste, Offense Level Up, Charge, or Defense Level Up next turn (value 2 at Threadspin Ⅳ).
messages.パッシブ「無限の憎悪」: 自分に状態異常かマイナス効果があり、メインターゲットか: **Passive — Infinite Hatred**: When he has a status effect or negative effect, and the main target or a target attacking him has a positive effect, status effect infliction and Poise and Charge gain increase by 1. The condition is strict.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 精神力が最も高い対象を狙い、精神力ダメージを与える。ほとんどの敵よ: **Corrosion skill**: Targets the highest-SP target and deals SP damage. Allies' SP tends to be higher than most enemies', so it likely tends to attack allies.
messages.普段使いの火力は高くない。耐性が死体袋と大きく違う(色欲が普通、暴食が抵抗)点を: Its everyday damage is not high. Make use of its resistances, which differ greatly from Bodysack (Normal to Lust, Endured against Gluttony), and pick it for fights with many Lust and Gluttony attacks, which Bodysack struggles against.
messages.多くの状態異常に関わるE.G.Oギフトがあるなら、ランダム付与でも恩恵を拾える。: If you have E.G.O Gifts tied to many status effects, it can pick up benefits even with random infliction.
messages.Ⅲ: 侵蝕スキルが広域(加重値2)になり、討伐時のバフ配布が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: The Corrosion skill becomes multi-target (2 Attack Weight), and buff distribution on kills is added.
messages.Ⅳ: 覚醒スキルが広域(加重値2)になり、的中時の付与が表面的中時から的中時に緩: **Ⅳ**: The Awakening skill becomes multi-target (2 Attack Weight), infliction is relaxed from Heads Hit to on hit, and the infliction cap and buff values rise.
messages.黒獣-酉 筆頭: S1(嫉妬)・S2(暴食)で必要資源を出せ、マッチ開始時に自分: **[Heishou Pack - You Branch Adept](persona:0714)**: S1 (Envy) and S2 (Gluttony) supply the required affinities, and he applies Burn to himself at the start of Clashes, easily meeting the passive's "status effect on himself" condition.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::狐雨: S1はマッチ敗北時に自分へ沈潜を付けるため、パッ: **[Lobotomy E.G.O:: Sunshower](persona:0705)**: His S1 applies Sinking to himself on Clash Lose, likely meeting the passive's condition. However, he cannot supply Gluttony.
